title: Building a story-driven math adventure with AI — looking to connect with creative developers
author: VitaminM-Paris
selftext:
**Title: Building a story-driven math adventure with AI — looking to connect with creative developers**  
Hi everyone!  
I’m a former McGill lecturer with 15+ years of experience teaching mathematics.  
I’ve been building **Vitamin M**, a story-driven math app that makes learning feel like an adventure rather than homework.  
I’ve created several early prototypes using AI tools and tested the concept with students.  
I’m now looking to connect with creative developers who are passionate about animation, interactive storytelling, and game development — and might be interested in building something exciting together.  
Here’s what I’ve been working on:  
**Vitamin M – Paris**  
[https://vitamin-m-paris-play.j-novitskaya.chatgpt.site](https://vitamin-m-paris-play.j-novitskaya.chatgpt.site/)  
Please select Paris to explore the adventure! 🥐  
Would love to connect with someone who shares my enthusiasm for bringing this idea to life!
